messages:
Priya (AE): Hey finance — quick deal-desk ask: Nautilus Labs wants Dedicated Reserved (4x A100 equiv) for 12 months. They asked for 35% off list, net45, and a US data residency addendum. Total list ~ $1,850,000/yr; they expect to sign by Friday if we accept. Can we get an approval or escalation path?

Aisha (Finance): Thanks — can you paste a tight deal summary (final $ request, requested terms) + why this should exceed our usual max enterprise discount?

Priya (AE): Deal summary: customer: Nautilus Labs (manufacturing analytics). List: $1.85M/yr. Customer request: 35% discount -> $1,202,500/yr. Asks: net45, US data residency addendum, SOC2 attestation on file. Strategic rationale: potential reference, will run high-volume inference, likely 3x expansion in 18 months. Sales propose offering 30% if finance/legal sign off, otherwise standard 20%. Need response by EOD tomorrow.

Evan (Sales Ops): Quick econ calc for visibility: ```List: 1,850,000 Discount 30% -> 1,295,000 Discount 35% -> 1,202,500 Unit cost (est amortized infra + support) ~ 350,000/yr Gross margin @30% disc = 1,295,000 - 350,000 = 945,000 (margin %) ~ 73% Gross margin @35% disc = 852,500 (margin %) ~ 71%``` Not catastrophic but sets a new high-water mark for discounts on Dedicated.

Aisha (Finance): Notes: 1) Our published enterprise discount cap is 20% w/o VP/Finance approval. 2) Net45 is ok only if credit check passes and Finance signs net terms. 3) Data residency addendum will likely add operational overhead — need SRE & Legal signoff for on-prem routing. 4) 35% is above the exception threshold; need CFO signoff for >30% and VP Sales for 25-30.

Priya (AE): Understood. Customer pushed hard on 35%. They said they'll do a co-marketing case study and commit to an expansion clause. Can we do conditional approval: 30% now if they accept 30% deposit + standard annual billing, and revisit on renewal?

Riley (Legal): Quick take: Legal is okay to sign data residency addendum with standard SLA language, but we need SRE to confirm we can support their residency requirements without a custom architecture change. Also request: add export controls clause and limit liability to standard caps. Will need to review final contract redlines; timeline ~48 hrs once we have the requested redlines.

Aisha (Finance): To present to CFO, I need: final proposed price, payment schedule (upfront %), confirmed SRE note on residency, and credit approval. If we can get a deposit of 30% and a credit check OK, Finance can consider approving up to 30% discount with conditions. Anything higher must go to @Marin.

Priya (AE): I'll chase customer for 30% upfront deposit and sign-off on co-marketing. Also will push for payment net30 if possible. Will ping SRE for residency feasibility.

Marin (CFO): @Aisha @Priya — I can approve up to 30% off for strategic anchor customers on a case-by-case basis. Conditions: 1) 30% upfront deposit (non-refundable for early termination), 2) credit check & receivables team sign-off on net45, 3) Legal sign-off on residency addendum and liability clauses, 4) margin floor after incremental cost >= 30%. If all met, I'll sign the exception. For >30% we need an exec committee note and VP Sales justification.

Aisha (Finance): Thanks @Marin. I'll track this as an exception request. Priya — please add the deposit clause and credit approval to the doc and tag me once SRE confirms residency.

Priya (AE): Will do. Thanks everyone — will update thread once customer confirms deposit or if they push back. :thumbsup:

Evan (Sales Ops): Flagging for future: add renewal escalation in contract to avoid repeated deep discounts upon renewal.

Riley (Legal): Also flag — if they require custom SSO/SCIM work, that should be scoped & billed separately (not part of the discount).

Priya (AE): Noted. Closing loop — aim to get deposit and SRE reply by tomorrow noon.

Aisha (Finance): Marking thread as "in flight". I'll queue CFO approval once asked conditions are met.

Marin (CFO): Thanks team.
